scientific_integrity: Exact finite checks and a complete analytic proof; literature priority is subject to historical uncertainty. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Homogeneous Potts weights, one specified color, nonadjacent false twins; the zero-temperature nonclique necessity requires q at least |V|. No claim for general graphs or for nonlinear conditional independence.
title: False-twin precision signs across the Potts coloring limit
